raw.details:
About the Competition

MANTRASTRA is a three-round AI Engineering Competition designed to evaluate participants' ability to understand, debug, develop, and optimise software using AI tools. The competition focuses on AI-assisted software engineering, code comprehension, and agentic development.

Eligibility & Team Formation

  • Open to students of all academic years from all colleges and universities.
  • Team size: 2–4 members.
  • Inter-college teams are allowed.
  • Inter-specialisation and interdisciplinary teams are allowed.
  • Each participant can register as a member of only one team.
  • Registration is free and can be completed on Unstop.

Competition Format

The competition will consist of three rounds:

Round 1: Build with AI

  • Interested students will have the opportunity to attend an offline workshop covering Prompt Engineering, Git & GitHub, and Agentic AI tools, followed by a quiz.
  • Students who do not opt for the workshop will directly participate in an online quiz conducted through Unstop.
  • The quiz will evaluate fundamental knowledge of AI, programming, software development, and related concepts.
  • Use of AI tools or external AI assistance is strictly prohibited during the quiz.
  • Participants must attempt the quiz independently.

Round 2: AI Code Comprehension Challenge (In-person)

  • Shortlisted teams will be provided with an unfamiliar codebase.
  • Teams must analyse the codebase, understand its architecture and execution flow, and identify and fix bugs.
  • Participants will evaluate AI-generated suggestions and explain their technical decisions.
  • Use of AI tools is permitted and encouraged in this round.
  • Evaluation will focus on code comprehension, debugging, critical thinking, and the ability to validate AI-generated outputs.

Round 3: Agentic Engineering Challenge (In-person)

  • Finalist teams will be required to build, test, and optimise a working application.
  • Participants can use AI assistants and autonomous AI agents throughout the development process.
  • Teams must demonstrate their working application before the judges.
  • Evaluation will focus on functionality, implementation, optimisation, effective AI utilisation, and the quality of the final demonstration.

AI Usage Policy

  • Round 1: AI tools are strictly prohibited during the quiz.
  • Round 2: AI tools are permitted for code analysis, debugging, and evaluating solutions.
  • Round 3: AI assistants and agents are permitted for application development, testing, and optimisation.
  • Participants must understand and be able to explain the solutions and code they submit.
  • Misuse of AI tools, plagiarism, or misrepresentation of work may result in disqualification.

Important Dates & Venue

  • Registration Deadline: 20 December 2026
  • Round 1 & Workshop: 22 December 2026
  • Round 2 & Round 3: 25–27 December 2026
  • Venue: MMMUT Campus, Gorakhpur.

Prizes & Recognition

  • Total Prize Pool: ₹12,000+
  • Certificates and further details will be communicated through the official channels of MMMUT RESO.

General Rules & Regulations

  • All participants must complete registration through either of the official registration platforms.
  • Each team must have 2–4 members.
  • Team composition cannot be changed after registration without approval from the organising committee.
  • Participants must follow the instructions and time limits announced for each round.
  • Teams must submit their solutions within the prescribed deadlines.
  • Plagiarism, copying another team's work, or any form of unfair practice is strictly prohibited.
  • Participants must not share confidential problem statements or solutions with other teams.
  • Teams must ensure that they can explain and justify their submitted work.
  • The organising committee reserves the right to disqualify teams violating competition rules.
  • The decisions of the judges and organising committee will be final and binding.

Important Instructions

  • Participants should bring their own laptops and chargers for the in-person rounds.
  • Carry a valid college ID card.
  • Participants are advised to follow the official social media channels of MMMUT RESO and TechSrijan for updates and announcements.
  • Further instructions, technical requirements, and round-specific details will be communicated to shortlisted teams.

Organised by MMMUT RESO under TechSrijan '27.

MANTRASTRA – The Code. The Challenge. The Arena.
